description: Maintained, versioned SporeDrive execution-policy defaults. These limits seed a managed task's execution record. A brief may LOWER a limit; raising an initial limit, extending it later, or unpausing requires the user-authorization-linked change path (change_limits with an authorization_ref) and is never a value a supervisor can compose for itself. See PLAN.md sections 1-2 and Fable finding F2.

notes.work_dispatches: Ordinary-task default: initial brief, one review, one repair brief, one repair verification. Every work-producing dispatch (including documentation/provenance) consumes it.
notes.review_launches: Primary review plus one repair verification. A review launch consumes BOTH this and the shared work_dispatches allowance.
notes.review_deadline_seconds: Hard elapsed limit per owned read-only reviewer process (owned CLI). Desktop active-review time is advisory only.
notes.expires_at: Explicit timestamp for unattended execution; null when attended. A finite value is required for any unattended/automation-driven task.
notes.technical_calls: Task-specific technical-debug adapter allowance, or null when the task has no model-call adapter.
notes.acceptance_calls: Task-specific frozen-acceptance adapter allowance, or null when not applicable.
